purpose: Test research decision A before changing any production label: can native-mesh geometry transitions be represented as persistent, bidirectionally consistent, past-only causal change-points with unique topological identities?

approval.scope: Research decision A selected explicitly by the user: one immutable read-only proof over exactly C01-C08; zero C09/C10/M-TARE/model inference/training/optimizer steps.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied A/a to retain geometry-change nodes and redefine them as persistent bidirectional causal change-points.

source.teacher_source: Sealed native perception mesh cross-section rays plus sealed TNG endpoints and spline traversal identity.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of the existing sealed procedural Cano assets with full provenance.

sampling.temporal_context: Existing downstream student contract remains five causal frames: current plus four earlier one-metre frames.
sampling.independent_sampling_unit: Topology parent for leakage control; physical change-point identity for event diversity; adjacent frames are not counted as independent worlds or identities.
sampling.fit_inventory: C01-C06: 60 worlds and 142184 five-frame sequences; no fitting occurs in this proof.
sampling.selection_inventory: C07-C08: 20 worlds and 45942 five-frame sequences; used only to prove that the corrected Teacher has nonzero held-out development identities, not to tune a threshold.
sampling.effective_samples: Outcome-dependent causal labels are emitted only after the pre-registered persistence, two-direction, unique-match and endpoint-priority rules. No input edge, traversal, frame or world is deleted.

split.future_validation: C09 remains unconsumed until a corrected Teacher, model and C01-C08 selection contract are frozen.
split.strict_test: C10 and M-TARE benchmark worlds remain unread.

teacher.old_baseline: Historical per-direction frame mask: 5 m before/after median comparison, 1 m width or height threshold, followed by canonical-arc clustering without a bidirectional requirement.
teacher.main: Use the same 5 m comparison span and 1 m width/height thresholds. Keep a two-sided signal only when its run spans at least the same 5 m scale. Pair only unique overlapping reverse-direction episodes with the same signed active geometry dimension. A past-only detector compares two completed 5-sample windows, closes the episode using observed history, and back-projects the boundary. Only points with exactly one causal match in both directions may emit labels.
teacher.endpoint_semantics: Within the existing 10 m node-event radius, degree-two endpoints share one node identity across incident edges. Degree-one and degree-at-least-three endpoints remain terminal/junction by priority. Two degree-two endpoints in range are ambiguous and emit nothing.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: Mesh, TNG, spline, identity, future pose/frame and test-world data remain Teacher/evaluation-only and are never student input.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.scope: Exact 80 worlds, 8039 edges, 16078 directed traversals, 252430 full geometry frames and 188126 sequences.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.identity_contract: Every emitted point has persistent evidence in both directions, exactly one past-only causal match in each direction, one identity, no label collision and terminal/junction priority.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.nonvacuous_training_capacity: At least 500 emitted geometry-transition observations, preserving the already frozen minimum per-class training-support floor; both C01-C06 and C07-C08 contain at least one emitted identity.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.comparison: Report every old identity as uniquely mapped, ambiguous or unmatched within the existing 10 m node radius; mapping is diagnostic and never creates a new label.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.family_reporting: Report old/new identities, emitted points and causal observations separately for all ten topology families; a family is not forced to contain a geometry change when the objective geometry has none.

failure_policy: Any source/count/config drift, C09/C10/M-TARE/model/training read, fewer than 500 causal observations, empty fit or selection identities, non-unique bidirectional/causal support, identity collision, endpoint-priority violation, nonfinite delay, timeout or disk overrun seals FAIL. Do not tune a radius, span, threshold, family quota or delete an event after seeing the result.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU/Open3D cross-section rays over 80 already materialized worlds; zero GPU.

retention: Retain full per-world, per-point, directional, causal-label and old/new mapping evidence; retain PNG/PDF/SVG figure, machine-readable source, provenance, raw log, metrics, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
